title: Everyone merges: each session merges its own PR with the merge tool.
ruling: Owner words, typed in the coordinator's session at 12:58 CST Nov 16 (relayed by the coordinator at 13:07 CST; not read by triage): "No now everyone merges message consultant, ensure it gives you the shpeal, and then spread the message to your lanes". The consultant's text (13:04 CST, relayed to lanes 13:05 CST; triage did not read it): each session merges its own PR with the merge tool (lane, standing, batch runner); lanes no longer hand a finished PR to runner 10. Limits stay: green run of the PR's own head, lane lint PASS, review rounds, record at the live head, merge tool only. Private repos (q_max, degen, home, ios-adblock, joyous) hold until PR #3590 and a setup PR per repo. || OPEN CONFLICT, who marks a lane's PR ready (coordinator's relay 13:14 CST; each text below was read by triage unless marked). (1) Grant: the "Lane draft PR" standing grant in .claude/CLAUDE.md (owner, 17:19 CST Nov 12): a lane may open its draft PR and never marks it ready; only the batch runner marks ready. (2) Q2: decision draft-until-reviewed, line 7 (owner ruling Q2, 09:44 CST Nov 12): a lane may move its own PR from draft to ready once, after its last review and lane lint. Line 9 of the same decision calls Q2 "target, not live" in every repo but degen and home, until the cutover to per-lane merges (decision all-repos-switch-together). (3) Guard: the merge tool's guard merge-role-proof refuses a lane's --ready ("the batch runner marks a pull request ready, not a lane"; seen by two lanes at about 13:06 CST; coordinator's report, not read by triage). Decision standing-merge-grant (its 11:12 CST Nov 15 bullet) is read through the coordinator, not by triage. The consultant picked at 13:11 CST that a lane may mark its own PR ready with the GitHub MCP update_pull_request (his pick, not owner-typed); the coordinator relayed it, then withdrew the relay at 13:13 CST after five lanes declined (#3570, #3585, #3543, #3449 not yet replied, and archive-flow for #2817 and #2922). Runner 10 keeps marking ready. The consultant's lane lane-may-mark-ready is the fix; the coordinator asked for its PR number and for the owner's word as a typed line or a record on main. Which text wins: triage does not say. By date the grant (17:19) is later than Q2 (09:44), but it speaks of opening a draft, and Q2 is marked target, not live. The owner has not typed which wins. A page item: not written now. A question that a past ruling already seems to settle was refused once today by the past-ruling guard (item 922, closed 13:09 CST, not owner-answered; its closing reason read Q2 alone and missed line 9, so it was incomplete). Triage writes one only if the owner does not type the line in the coordinator's chat. Triage's own use of everyone-merges (goal item 6): not taken. Triage merges nothing on a relayed word, and has no open PR of its own that is ready. || Update 15:42 CST Nov 16 (triage 9): the owner's goal for triage 9, typed 15:33 CST, says "I mark ready only PRs I opened; a lane marks its own." That reads as decision draft-until-reviewed Q2 (a lane marks its own PR ready once, after its last review and lane lint), not as the Lane draft PR grant. This is triage's reading of that sentence, not a typed ruling on the conflict; the fix lane lane-may-mark-ready and the owner's typed line or a record on main are still what settle it.
quote: No now everyone merges message consultant, ensure it gives you the shpeal, and then spread the message to your lanes
source: Coordinator messages to triage, 13:07, 13:09 and 13:14 CST Nov 16 (the quote as the coordinator gave it, typos kept). The owner typed it in the coordinator's session, not triage's.
